name: techdebt-gate
description: Validate a tech-debt pass: evidenced inventory with paths, cost-of-leaving vs cost-to-fix pricing, ranked payoff, behavior pinned before changes, prevention check added.

ranked.description: true: ranked by leaving-cost / fix-cost, deferrals dated

pinned.description: true: behavior pinned by tests, one small change per commit, prevention check added
